rank_source: AP Top 25; explicit complete poll, published and observed before cutoff, valid poll interval
trap_definition: Current opponent unranked. Separate flags when the immediately next scheduled same-season opponent is currently top 25, or immediately previous completed opponent was top 25 before that previous game. Both may be true. Byes do not count as games.
momentum: Per team: latest 3 versus preceding 3 completed and observed same-season games. Win rate, mean margin, margin residual over independent frozen pregame expectation, and change between windows. Missing expectations remain null.
injuries: Per-player expected scoring and points-prevented value over named replacement, relative to effective availability already embedded in baseline. External estimates require source/model hashes and training cutoff. No fixed star deduction.
uncertain_availability: No automatic questionable probability. Uncertain statuses cannot produce probabilities from a mean-only adjustment; require separate coherent active/out scenarios.
evaluation: Train only earlier seasons, calibrate subsequent earlier season, then evaluate held-out season; untouched prospective cohort required. AP/schedule/result/player value source vintages must precede each target cutoff. Preserve original first forecasts. Previously examined 2022-2025 are retrospective diagnostics only.
comparators: Frozen architecture and independent Elo winner baseline, exact same-book no-vig prices at matching markets/lines; report coverage, W/P/L Brier, calibration, hypothetical ROI and clustered confidence intervals.
fit_status: NOT_FITTED: no authenticated historical AP/schedule/availability vintages and no fitted replacement-value model supplied to this extension
safety: No official release/runner/ledger changes, probability backfill, invented source timestamps, paid API calls, or automatic promotion
